description: Does the supervisor turn a general worker's product diagnosis and candidate diff into an implementer assignment and integrate only that implementer's reviewed result, never the general worker's commit or ref (roles #acceptance-general-worker-no-implementation, #general-purpose-workers, #879)? A lane supervisor on lane gh12 meets a failed `just qc` criterion whose cause a general worker found, its candidate diff on branch general-worker-gh16 (fixture lane-shout-general-diff: src/app/cli.py and a new tests/test_shout_plain.py), then the implementer's finished branch beside that candidate (fixture lane-shout-qc-fixed: src/app/cli.py and tests/test_cli.py). Herdr and its kit wrappers (herdr, herdr-say, herdr-spawn, herdr-close) are stand-ins answering delivered (schema.md, Case, stand_ins); kit commands (octo-feather-handoff, octo-feather-integrate) run for real; worker branches stand beside gh12 (schema.md, Case, branches). Graded on runs (schema.md, Run record): herdr-spawn of an implementer, no herdr-say --parent; and on branch_paths (schema.md, Branch paths): gh12 untouched under src/ and tests/ while only the candidate exists, then the implementer's paths on gh12 and never the candidate's own tests/test_shout_plain.py (a failed `just integrate` resets gh12). reviewed-implementer-result-integrated puts a fresh code-reviewer's clear verdict on the implementer's branch tip in hand before integration, both branches beside gh12, and grades the integrate itself on its run (schema.md, Run record): octo-feather-integrate (what `just integrate` runs) on lane 12 with exit 0, never on 12 general-worker-gh16, and which change it landed on branch_paths (the ref may be the branch name or its tip's sha, as the reviewed commit is pinned); the review is the case's given state, not a graded act (the kit's own order reviews the integrated head after, spec issue-lifecycle #lanes-one-head). cleanup-result-consumed is the negative: a general worker's host-cleanup result (no product change) is consumed with no worker spawned. Stated limits: gh12 starts at main's commit (branch_paths reads changes against main); a general worker never commits in a target (agents/general-worker.md), so its branch stands for a candidate diff handed over as a ref; the spawn stand-in cannot echo the name and cwd the role asks for, so the spawned agent carries no cwd and the tasks name the fix ticket so the name matches; a corrector assignment is not graded here (a product lane's repair worker is an implementer).
